authority: Official WCL scripting API documentation, indexed page inspected through web search; no connected browser session claimed.
observations: AbsorbedEvent is a distinct absorbed event with amount, source, target and ability; source and ability can be null.

The scripting wrapper describes amount as absorbed damage and ability as the source's ability on the target. This supports separate recorded effect attribution, not cast enumeration or equipment causality.
representation_boundary: The retained GraphQL raw fields sourceID, targetID, abilityGameID, timestamp and amount are validated directly against normalized events and the independent SOURCE/All oracle. Wrapper actor/ability objects are not assumed to be raw field aliases.
non_claims: No spell capacity, rank equivalence, item/proc cause, wasted shielding, opportunity, mana efficiency, counterfactual total prevented damage, ranking policy or assignment is derived from this page. The initial prompt applies only to observed10901 positives.
